scientific_integrity: The exact modulus classification is proved by 3-adic residue rigidity. No external or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact scope is the equal-weight cross digit set with contraction 1/3, integer frequencies, and a nonoptimal third-region cutoff.
The 1983-12-01 date is explicit in a bibliographic index; only the publication month/year is corroborated elsewhere, so day-level earliest-publication precision is a residual source risk.
Older fractal-diffraction or Fourier literature might contain a covering theorem; bounded searches did not identify one.
The finite checker supplements but does not replace the analytic proof.
title: The first two integer Fourier levels of the uniform Vicsek cross measure
